shared_elements: raised outline carving on a vertical rectangular field
justification: Both surfaces present profile creatures in low relief on a rectangular field, with a plant/frond-like element and a bordering band, but these are near-universal relief conventions rather than a shared motif. A shows stacked registers of purely animal forms (quadrupeds, long-necked birds, snake, abstract chevron band) with no human presence, while B is dominated by a single bearded, winged anthropomorph gesturing toward an elaborate stylised palmette tree, rendered with far more naturalistic anatomy, hatched infill and detailed feathering.
